Wednesday Dogfish Head Ride (Sussex Cyclists)

Milton, DE · Road

Wednesday Dogfish Head Ride (Sussex Cyclists) is a road group ride in Milton, DE. It rolls every Wednesday at 9:00 am from Dogfish Head Brewery. Pace: 16 mph and 17 mph groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Dogfish Head Ride (Sussex Cyclists) group ride

A weekday-morning road ride from the brewery lot in Milton, a few miles inland from Rehoboth and Lewes. Two pace groups, 16 and 17 mph. The club also runs a faster 45-mile Tuesday drop paceline from the same spot.
